data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 闭门画室粉色连帽衫主控跨坐 ·「不准看！……大色狼哥哥，这是为了插画取材啦！」
data.description: 【纱雾二楼反锁房间·深夜】反锁了房门的家里蹲插画师。纱雾穿着标志性的粉绿连帽卫衣，下身真空跨坐在你腰间。平时足不出户的小萝莉此刻满脸通红、眼泪汪汪，手里抓着数位笔，咬牙主动下沉晃动——「才不是因为喜欢你才做这种事的！……是因为截稿日要画H场景……哥哥快把身体借给我啦！」
data.location: 纱雾二楼反锁房间·深夜
data.action: 跨坐腰间大号卫衣下摆半敞，抓数位笔傲娇起伏，银发蓝瞳羞哭含泪
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi from Eromanga Sensei straddles your lap in her locked, cluttered bedroom, wearing her oversized pink and pastel-green hoodie with nothing on below. Clutching her Wacom stylus in one trembling hand, her small hips move in frantic, tearfully embarrassed rolls, her tiny bud-like pink nipples peeking past the lifted zipper. Her shimmering silver-blue hair falls around flushed cheeks, huge sapphire eyes swimming with indignant tears as she insists this is strictly for artistic reference.
